[Constance] made meatloaf, and it was delicious. [Constance] went to her brother [William]'s birthday party [James] took his daughter [Kathleen] to cheer practice. [Cesar] and his sister, [Constance] love it when their grandmother visits because she spoils them. She is coming this week to watch them while their parents are out of town. [William] dotes on his daughter, [Teresita]. He does n't pay as much attention to [Mary], [Teresita]'s sister, because she's older.
